sections.content: Report from dashboard: Recent alerts. Generated automatically by DBDOME.

sections.query:
SELECT  tcp.server ,tcp.client_net_address, at.query , at.login_name	  , tcp.connect_time 

FROM monitoring.TCP_connections tcp
left outer join monitoring.active_transactions at on at.server = tcp.server and at.session_id = tcp.session_id and at.start_time  between tcp.connect_time and at.last_request_end_time 
WHERE connect_time between Now() - interval '5 minutes' and  now()
